dedupe_keys.name: code accompanying the paper on aircraft path planning in continuous environments with deep reinforcement learning

description: TU Delft provides research code for aircraft path planning in continuous environments using deep reinforcement learning. The source distinguishes a discrete environment with grid discretisation and Dijkstra path processing from a continuous environment based on a fork of the BlueSky air-traffic simulator. Plugins train the reinforcement-learning algorithm and evaluate paths. A third folder produces policy visualisations. Both environments use the same Eurostat population grids. The release contents and related resources follow the native description above. Coverage: The reviewed metadata does not establish a complete common temporal interval. Access: public 4TU.ResearchData descriptive metadata identifies this release. Licence: GPL-3.0. Cost and current distribution access remain unknown. Caveats: The configuration is a research extension of BlueSky. It is not equated with the base simulator. The source does not state the programming language, runtime input schema or geographic evaluation extent.
